description.en: Offline search in images, scanned and mixed PDFs, and images embedded in Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Incremental indexing with highlighted previews. Once indexed, type the picture's words straight into the search box.
description.zh: 离线搜索图片、扫描与混排 PDF、Word / PPT / Excel 内嵌图片中的文字。选择目录，后台增量识别，预览高亮命中位置。建好索引后直接在搜索框输入图片里的文字即可搜到。

notes.zh: 用 Win顺 0.44.0 的共用窗口代码重新编译：窗口重新创建后照样保持边框和样式，任务栏里显示应用自己的图标；列表滚动时滚动条会亮起来。需要 Win顺 0.44.0。权限不变。
notes.en: Rebuilt with WinShun 0.44.0's shared window code: windows keep their frame and style when they are made anew and show the app's own icon on the taskbar; list scroll bars light up while scrolling. Needs WinShun 0.44.0. Permissions unchanged.
